fault_onset_resolution_rule.description: Resolve each of the 81 fault-log rows to a single onset datetime.
fault_onset_resolution_rule.rule: fault_onset = start_time if start_time is non-empty, else log_time
fault_onset_resolution_rule.confidence: well-supported by 3 independent lines of evidence (block<->locked-day date correspondence, preserved time-of-day, index-1-11 dates matching the already-extracted unlocked day) -- not organizer-confirmed
unresolved_details: block=8 spans two different start_time calendar dates (2020-05-29 and 2020-05-30)
a consistent +6:00 time-of-day shift appears for log_block in {4,5}, cause not determined
whether index 1-11 were part of the scored evaluation or an unscored preview batch is not certain

pre_failure.justification: observed global minimum gap between consecutive fault onsets is 25.0 minutes (0/80 gaps below 25min); 20min leaves a 5-minute safety margin, contamination-free for the full event population at this window size

during_failure.justification: fixed by the dataset's own documented `duration` field, constant 5min for all 81 events -- not a design choice

post_failure.definition: not defined in this protocol version
post_failure.note: no post-failure window is frozen yet; any future diagnosis-only extension must freeze its own window and overlap rule before use

extended_context_window_60min.reason: only contamination-free for ~51/81 (63%) of events at 60 minutes; would require either restricting to that eligible subset or per-event truncation, neither of which is decided here

usage_rule.diagnosis_tasks: may use PRE-FAILURE, DURING-FAILURE, and (once defined) POST-FAILURE telemetry, but must be labeled as diagnosis, never mixed into a prediction feature set

entity_scope.filtering: none -- extract all cmdb_id entities present in a given telemetry day, not restricted to the 16 fault-targeted entities, to preserve a comparison/negative population for future use

call_traces_outcome_fields.note: usable as an input feature only when aggregated over PAST calls within the PRE-FAILURE window, never as a feature describing the same call being predicted

fault_log_timing_fields.role: define the T0 cutoff, not an input feature

extraction_dates.note: verified directly against the raw zip's own file listing this pass (15 daily zips total, 2020_04_11 already extracted, 14 remaining); the 10 dates 2020_05_22 through 2020_05_31 are password-locked (inner _lock.zip, per sha256sum.txt/unzip_all.sh) and require the documented archive password before extraction

currently_eligible_events_for_prediction.reason: only these events' full PRE-FAILURE window falls within the one already-extracted telemetry day (2020-04-11)

missing_telemetry_handling: record explicit MISSING / count=0, never impute
overlapping_events_handling: none exist at the frozen 20-minute window; no overlap-resolution rule needed at this window size
determinism: pure filter (entity membership + time-window membership), no randomness, fully reproducible from this frozen file plus the raw zip checksum

power_assessment_summary.binary_fault_vs_no_fault_detection: UNDERPOWERED / EXPLORATORY -- no negative-window population defined yet
power_assessment_summary.5class_fault_category_classification: UNDERPOWERED / INCONCLUSIVE-PRONE for rare classes (n=5, n=7)
power_assessment_summary.cross_dataset_comparison_with_alibaba: qualitative only, never a joint statistical test
